decisions.reason: As a large expanding telecom provider, the firm is likely to keep this cloud contact centre service because it extends the core portfolio at relatively low incremental cost and its commercial value is still being tested rather than clearly disproven.

The firm is likely to keep this call number routing platform because it is very close to the established business, appears to have a clearer market commitment from its standalone page, and should be a low-cost option to retain while demand develops.
